ctfmod.msg.no_break: Only the owning team can break this point!
ctfmod.help.setup1: Setup: /team add red, /team modify red color red, /team join red <player>
ctfmod.help.setup2: Do the same for the blue team (blue color). Only red/blue colored teams can play.
ctfmod.help.setup3: Place the Red and Blue points (Capture The Flag creative tab).
ctfmod.help.rules1: Capture: stand on an enemy-colored point. 2 players = x2 speed, 3 = x3 ...
ctfmod.help.rules2: A defender on the point freezes the capture at its current progress.
ctfmod.help.rules3: Only the owning team can break a point. Points are explosion-proof. Each flag has a colored beacon beam.
